user.about: I build reliable data platforms, cloud-native services, and AI-powered solutions that turn complex information into practical products and business insight.
user.aboutLead: I combine strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in data engineering, cloud systems, and machine learning to deliver thoughtful, production-ready solutions.

sectionLabels.contactText: I am open to conversations about data platforms, AI products, and cloud engineering opportunities where thoughtful systems can create real impact.

experience.description: Building scalable, cloud-native data and AI systems that support reliable products, intelligent automation, and data-driven decision-making.
duties: Architected and implemented data pipelines and backend services for scalable, production-ready workflows.
Built and maintained cloud-based applications and integrations in AWS environments.
Developed REST APIs and data services that supported internal platforms and AI-driven features.
Automated deployment and delivery processes through CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborated with engineers, data scientists, and product teams to ship reliable solutions.
Improved system performance, observability, and maintainability across critical services.

experience.description: Supported IT and Computer Science students through practical teaching, assessment, and one-to-one guidance.
duties: Invigilated semester tests with care and integrity.
Marked tests and weekly assignments with clear feedback.
Delivered individual and group tutoring for IT and Computer Science students.
achievements: Translated complex concepts into approachable learning experiences.
Balanced assessment responsibilities with student mentorship.

education.description: Specialised in cybersecurity, data protection, and phishing-email detection using Natural Language Processing.
Built a rigorous foundation in mathematical modelling, analytics, and computational problem-solving.
Completed a science-focused curriculum that established a foundation for further technical study.

projects.description: Developed and evaluated deep learning models for mosquito species classification using transfer learning and computer vision, contributing to image-based identification for vector surveillance and public health research.

projects.projName: Android Mobile POS App for Street Vendors
projects.description: Designed and built an Android point-of-sale application for informal traders, simplifying inventory tracking, sales recording, and business analytics through an intuitive mobile experience.
Built and evaluated deep learning models for satellite image classification through feature engineering, model optimisation, and performance evaluation in a competitive research setting.

Developed PhishHunter, a phishing email detection system using Natural Language Processing and machine learning. Evaluated TF-IDF, Word2Vec, and Doc2Vec text representations with classifiers including Logistic Regression and SVM to improve phishing detection accuracy.

Contributed to the design and development of scalable enterprise data and AI solutions, building cloud-native data pipelines, backend APIs, automated CI/CD workflows, and machine learning deployment processes for production environments.
